analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10=0.5325: Movies_and_TV 0.570, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.585, Electronics 0.390, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.585. This is 0.0062 below the reported balanced-BCE reference (0.5387) and 0.0338 above the supplied sampled-softmax result (0.4987). Because both the objective and architecture changed relative to sampled softmax, that improvement cannot be attributed to pooling alone. The result does not support a pooling gain over the reported balanced-BCE reference; Electronics remains the weakest category. No causal explanation is established by this single trial.
code_summary: One independent ConvRec checkpoint per category, with tied 96-dimensional item embeddings, learned item biases, and four residual causal convolution blocks using dilations 1, 2, 4, 8. Undropped embeddings form padding-masked cumulative prefix means, transformed through a learned tanh projection and sigmoid-gated into the convolution output before final normalization. Training uses balanced positive/negative BCE, 256 shared uniform negatives with target collisions excluded, and at most 2048 supervised positions per batch. Seed 42, length 64, dropout 0.25, AdamW, validation checkpoint selection, and 35-epoch early stopping are retained. The exported predictor reconstructs the same architecture and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category. Planned RNG-isolated architecture and predictor-parity checks were absent from the supplied implementation.
